IOHN.|255 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>die: it self remaineth alone. but if it die, it bringeth much fruite. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=25}}† He that loueth his life, shal lose it: and he that hateth his life in this vvorld, doth keepe it to life euerlasting. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=26}}† If any man minister to me, let him folovv me: and vvhere I am, there also shal my minister be. If any man minister to me, my father vvil honour him.⊣ {{verse|chapter=12|verse=27}}† Novv my soule is troubled. And vvhat shal I say? Father, saue me from this houre. But therfore came I into this houre. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=28}}† Father, glorifie thy name. A voice therfore came from heauen, Both I haue glorified it, and againe I vvil glorifie it. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=29}}† The multitude therfore that stoode and had heard, said that it thundered. Others said, An Angel spake to him. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=30}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvered, and said, This voice came not for me, but for your sake. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=31}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Holy roode day ''Septemb. 14''. in latin, ''Exaltatio S. Crucis''.}}Novv is the iudgement of the vvorld: novv the Prince of this vvorld shal be cast forth. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=32}}† And I, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 3, 14.''}}* if I be exalted from the earth, vvil dravv al things to my self. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=33}}† (and this he said, signifying vvhat death he should die.) {{verse|chapter=12|verse=34}}† The multitude ansvvered him, VVe haue heard out of the lavv, that {{sc|Christ}} abideth for euer: and hovv saiest thou, The Sonne of man must be exalted? VVho is this Sonne of man? {{verse|chapter=12|verse=35}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} therfore said to them, Yet a litle vvhile, the light is among you. VValke vvhiles you haue the light, that the darkenesse ouertake you not. And he that vvalketh in darkenesse, knovveth not vvhither he goeth. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=36}}† VVhiles you haue the light, beleeue in the light, that you may be the children of light. ⊣ These things {{sc|Iesvs}} spake and he vvent avvay, and hid him self from them.⊣

{{verse|chapter=12|verse=37}}† And vvhereas he had done so many signes before them, they beleeued not in him: {{verse|chapter=12|verse=38}}† that the saying of Esay the Prophet might be fulfilled, vvhich he said, ''Lord, vvho hath beleeued the hearing of vs? and the arme of our Lord to whom hath it bene reuealed''?{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Esa. 53, 1.''}} {{verse|chapter=12|verse=39}}† Therfore they {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ If any man aske (saith S. Augustine) why they could not beleeue: I answer roundly, because they would not. ''Tract. 33. in Io''. See the meaning of this speach Annot. ''Mat. 13, 15. Mar. 4, 12''.}}∷ could not beleeue, because Esay said againe, {{verse|chapter=12|verse=40}}† ''He hath blinded their eies, and indurated their hart: that they may not see vvith their eies, nor vnderstand vvith their hart, and be conuerted, and I heale them''.{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Esa. 6, 9. Mt. 13, 14. Mr. 4, 12. Lu. 8, 10. Act. 28, 27.''}} {{verse|chapter=12|verse=41}}† These things said Esaie, vvhen he savv his glorie, and spake of him. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=42}}† But yet of the Princes also many beleeued in him: but {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ This is the case of many principal men in such countries where heresie hath the vpperhand, who know and beleeue the Catholike faith: but making choise rather to keepe mans fauour then Gods, they dare not confesse the same. Such may pray that God and the world agree together: for els it is seen whose part they wil take.}}∷ for the Pharisees they did not confesse, that they might not be cast out of the Synagogue. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=43}}† for they loued the glorie of men more, then the glorie of God.

{{verse|chapter=12|verse=44}}† But {{sc|Iesvs}} cried, and said, He that beleeueth in me, doth not beleeue in me, but in him that sent me. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=45}}† And he that<noinclude>{{rh|||seeth}}</noinclude>
